items.title: 5.2.1 Testing aur debugging ki ahmiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.2.1 (PDF 64, printed 60), paragraph for paragraph with the English; Code Explanation boxes and runnable examples added 2026-10-29.

blocks.text: Testing aur debugging is liye zaroori hain ke application har haal mein sahi chale. Yeh software jaari (release) hone se pehle ghaltiyan pakar kar door karti hain. Baqaida testing chalte waqt achanak nakami (failure) se bachati hai. Debugging ghalti ki wajah dhoondti aur use jaldi theek karti hai. Mil kar yeh dono bharosa (reliability) aur user ka aitmaad barhati hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Aisi suraton par baat karein jahan ghaltiyon ki wajah se program nakam hua, aur samjhayein ke testing kyun zaroori hai.

items: Testing release se pehle ghaltiyan pakarti hai; debugging un ki wajah dhoond kar theek karti hai.
Dono mil kar bharosa (reliability) barhate hain.
